en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European street scene. Multi‑story townhouses and civic-style buildings line a broad cobblestone street bordered by bare trees, suggesting late autumn or winter. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand along the street, and a small cart is visible in the center. At the top of the image in red printed script is the caption indicating the location: 'Pirna a. Elbe' and 'Obere Burgstrasse'.
